name: Audio Content Test (dev)
author: Hails
description: Dev only (PR #36), off by default: enable it in the mod menu, or run with SKATE3_MODS_ENABLE=dev-audio-content-test. Its audio.json replaces DownTown's main zone bed with soft noise, the Baby_Cry_1 emitter bank with a beep, a tunnel zone's volume, a speech take, a taxi's idle rpm, makes a self-made crossfade bank DownTown's zone-transition crossfade (a declared layout), and adds a siren location set on the format-demo map (district DownTown). The script posts a retail c_emitter with F6 and releases it with F7, sets a global with F5 (again to restore), and shows the last audio events and a watched MixMap output on the HUD. audio/moddability-2: F8 plays a siren through the native mixer (the default routing, default reach) and a beep, F9 toggles tuning writes (taxi idle rpm, a reverb preset value), F10 places a mod emitter (its own emitter instance, the default) and a reverb zone at the skater, F11 toggles rules muting grind starts and replacing the landing with a beep at a fixed spot 10 m east; audio.json layers a quiet beep on every pop at the skater and one above every honking car (positional rules). Turning the mod on or off restarts the game's sound (a short cut).

events.label: Show audio events
events.description: Subscribe to every audio event and show the last ones.
